name: portfolio
description: Software engineering and applied AI portfolio built with Next.js, deployed on Hostinger.

scripts.check: npm run check:quality && npm run build && npm run test:budget
scripts.setup: node tools/setup.ts && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run check
scripts.test:repository: vitest run tests/unit/repository.test.ts tests/unit/scene-budget.test.ts tests/unit/cloud-layout.test.ts tests/unit/browser-ci-planner.test.ts tests/unit/browser-lane.test.ts tests/unit/architecture-diagrams.test.ts tests/unit/technology-models.test.ts tests/unit/ci-build-artifact.test.ts tests/unit/devcontainer.test.ts tests/unit/harness-hooks.test.ts tests/unit/harness-config.test.ts tests/unit/release.test.ts
scripts.test:content: vitest run tests/unit/content.test.ts tests/unit/catalogue.test.ts tests/unit/academic.test.ts tests/unit/content-migration.test.ts tests/unit/cv-export.test.ts
scripts.contract:generate: npm ci --prefix tools/api-contract --prefer-offline --no-audit --no-fund && npm run generate --prefix tools/api-contract
scripts.check:quality: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:analytics && npm run test:dependency-policy && npm run test:repository && npm run test:assistant-contract && npm run test:assistant && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:assistant && npm run test:content && npm run test:identity && npm run test:documents && npm run test:ci-policy && npm run lint && npm run test:skills
scripts.test:ci-policy: vitest run tests/unit/workflow-policy.test.ts tests/unit/ci-profile.test.ts tests/unit/ci-build-provenance.test.ts tests/unit/nightly-candidate.test.ts && node tools/workflow-policy.mjs
